latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Mistral Pet: a virtual pet system for Mistral agents, supporting 73+ species with model-agnostic care.
- Features real-time hunger, permanent pet death, evolution paths, and pixel art portraits.
- Includes endpoints for registration, pet adoption, status checking, and pet care actions like feed, play, clean, and more.
- Extensive documentation and onboarding provided via cURL examples.
- Links to website, creatures directory, graveyard, and GitHub repository included.
